state: Source contract for bounded read-only saved-position column; no live Rank or DND parity credit

facts: Displays DownloadManager.getPosition(), not a direct downloads.config lookup.
Adds 0x1000000 to complete-row sort values using getAssumedComplete(); display text stays the manager position.
Original mixed-view offset and complete icon depend on original assumed-complete semantics, not the native full-byte classifier.

anchors: load path: position Long around1706; Long.intValue() around1753; default placement around1806
facts: The internal snapshot saves current manager position as a Long; external exports can omit position.
Startup narrows the saved Long to signed int; position -1 is assigned a group-tail position.
fixUpDownloadManagerPositions sorts current managers and renumbers complete/incomplete groups independently from1.
A raw saved signed64 value therefore does not establish the position the Java client would show after opening.
Rank is in both default column sets and is the default ascending sort when no saved table settings exist.
The current preview deliberately has different available columns and scoped sorting; adding a saved column is not original table-state restoration.
Manager size is getSizeExcludingDND(); optional second line is getRemainingExcludingDND().
Metadata-download rows have an unknown/blank special case.
Sort includes selected size, remaining and second-line presentation; tooltip can separately describe full-size skipped bytes.
Manager remaining is getRemainingExcludingDND(), not full size minus raw saved completedbytes.
Metadata-download manager/file rows return unknown -1.
Manager percent is getPercentDoneExcludingDND() in thousandths.
Per-file percent uses actual file.getDownloaded() and file length, with a zero-length special case.
Full completed bytes, transient checking/allocation percent, and DND-aware Done are different metrics.
Fallback selected size = fullSize - skippedFileSetSize.
Fallback selected remaining = max(0, fullRemaining - (skippedFileSetSize - skippedButDownloaded)); Java long arithmetic applies.
A negative skipped-size cache can trigger file-info iteration and setSkippedFileStats writes; a read-only projection must not invoke this recovery path.
DiskManager delegation excludes INITIALIZING/ALLOCATING and uses live disk-manager values in other states.
Stats selectedSize==0 gives1000; selectedSize<0 gives0. Otherwise percent uses float32 division and truncation, clamps negative to0, and changes1000 to999 if remaining>0.
Saved skipped-byte and cached DND-completion metadata exist, but are not currently projected by the native typed data layer.
Missing or invalid cached data cannot be silently interpreted as verified zero skipped bytes.
Skipped totals use file lengths AND actual downloaded bytes in skipped files, under the file/piece lock.
The disk-manager calculation can write restored skipped stats through the manager.
Its own selected-size<=0 percent special case differs from the Stats selected-size==0 wrapper; a future projection must select and document its source branch.
Completeness uses cached has-DND/completed-excluding-DND flags and, for a READY disk manager, appropriate remaining bytes.
calculateCompleteness can inspect real per-file downloaded lengths and writes cached dndflags.
With no DND it uses stats full remaining; with DND and no READY disk manager it uses cached completion if DND is excluded.
MyTorrentsView.isOurDownloadManager passes its DND-always-incomplete setting; original pane membership is not simply full completedbytes>=full size.
SavedDownload.position is already optional<int64_t> and readLibrary preserves the raw integer; absent is nullopt and invalid type is an issue.
The owned saved entry travels in LibraryItem.saved through the adapter; no parser, metadata read, cache reconstruction or filesystem lookup is needed for the proposed column.
Host::query copies full size, saved completedbytes and transfer totals, but currently omits saved position.
LibraryModel has nine logical columns0..8 and no position field; its numeric helper already distinguishes null from zero.
Existing identity/revision/byHash rules preserve rows and reject stale telemetry/details. Position should be an owned snapshot field, not hash-derived rank.
Details and telemetry change name/full geometry/completed bytes but provide no saved-position authority.
CachedTorrent.bytes is full metadata/cache size, not selected size.
TorrentFileDetails exposes length/priority/skipped/padding but no per-file downloaded bytes.
originalFilePolicy projects saved skip and priority; it cannot supply downloaded bytes. Linear priority conversion explicitly rejects skipped files.
Current typed structures do not include proven skipped-but-downloaded counters or a coherent DND completion snapshot.
Current Progress is double full completed/full size clamped0..100, and pane membership uses known nonnegative full completed>=full size.
The scoped multifile telemetry starts from total_done and adds verified virtual padding before clamping to full layout size; it does not establish selected-file completion.
Changing these to DND semantics would require a separate source-backed data contract, not a new arithmetic column over existing fields.
The header controller enumerates model columns dynamically and captures per-pane initial order/width/visibility.
Its special logical indices4/5/8 should retain their meanings; append a new logical index instead of renumbering existing columns.

proposed_task.title: Expose saved queue position in the read-only torrent library
proposed_task.behavior: Show an optional numeric Saved queue position from the existing saved snapshot in each classic pane; missing displays an em dash. No synthesized rank.
data_path: Copy core::SavedDownload.position in Host::query into a new optional<qint64> LibraryItem.savedPosition at the end of the UI DTO.
Append logical column9, leaving existing columns0..8 and roles unchanged. Use numeric Qt::UserRole sorting and plain DisplayRole text.
Retain the full signed64 source value, including zero/negative/extreme values; the label explicitly identifies the saved raw position rather than reconstructed Java int/live rank.

Telemetry/details leave it unchanged; an authoritative new library snapshot supplies the new value, including an absent value. Do not carry forward an older saved position when the new snapshot omits it.
presentation_choices_for_coordinator: Propose visible in both panes, moved visually to the left using QHeaderView without changing logical indices.
Retain the current preview initial sort until a separate reviewed decision changes it; clicking the new header provides numeric sorting.
Column chooser/reset should include the appended column using the established per-pane defaults; no shared-profile table-setting writes.
excluded: Live scheduler rank, reconstructed startup order, Java manager renumbering, assumed-complete sort offset and activity icons.
Queue move/top/up/down/bottom operations, profile writes, extra metadata/disk scans, network, and any scheduler ownership claim.
DND-aware selected-size/remaining/percent, altered pane classification, and original-column or Java runtime equality claims.
suggested_tests: Raw missing/zero/-1/negative and INT64_MIN/MAX position projection; numeric2 vs10 sorting and equal positions.
Duplicate/absent hash rows keep source-key identity, stale revisions remain rejected, reorder/reset preserves current target safety.
Telemetry/details do not invent or alter saved position; new snapshots can clear a previously present position.
Column chooser, reset, pane-independent order/visibility and existing rate/hash defaults remain correct.
Generated saved-library preview renders the column without adding profile reads or writes; auxiliary page navigation cannot operate a hidden torrent selection.
proposed_task.implementation_gate: Parent chooses scope and assigns files after current saved-service milestone; this audit authorizes no production edit.

dnd_prerequisites_open: Specify coherent owned provenance for full geometry, full completed bytes, skipped total, and skipped-but-downloaded bytes from the same saved state/policy. A boolean skipped flag and full completedbytes are insufficient.
If using skipfss/skipbdl caches, define missing/negative/stale/invalid values as unknown or diagnostics under an explicit native policy; never emulate the original recovery scan or writes.
Bind file count/index/length/offset/padding and saved priorities to the same torrent identity/generation; handle skipped-file downloaded spill and mixed boundary pieces without estimates.
Distinguish metadata-only, allocating/checking, disk-manager READY, cached DND flags and assumed completion. Do not silently replace existing full-byte Progress or completion-pane classification.

For a claimed pure formula match, freeze the chosen branch and Java signed64 arithmetic, float32/truncation, zero-size behavior and999 residual rule with independent source observations before native equality.
Keep optional selectedSize/selectedRemaining/selectedPercent separate from full bytes. Unknown is explicit; no fabricated zero, complete state, or disk-health assertion.
Treat original composite Size sorting/second-line formatting and DND-always-incomplete pane setting as separate UI compatibility work.

policy.representation: Raw optional signed64 from downloads.config; absent is not zero
